label: 1 Peter is addressed to Christians in the province of Galatia

place.note: The address names the Roman province of Galatia. Pinned to the Galatia province/region resource (619161). Distinct from the south-Galatian cities attested from Acts (Pisidian Antioch, Iconium, Lystra, Derbe); those are settlements, this is the province as a whole.

date.note: Composition of 1 Peter. Traditional Petrine authorship puts it before Peter's death under Nero (c. 64); the majority view holds it pseudonymous, c. 70–90. Harnack (p. 186 n.) assigns it to 'the earlier years of Domitian' (c. 81–85). Upper bound 96 (end of Domitian); a minority dates it into the early second century.

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 92–93 (register of communities traceable before Trajan)

notes: Harnack's register lists 'unnamed localities in Galatia (Gal. and 1 Pet. i. 1),' pairing the address of 1 Peter with Paul's Galatians as evidence for Christians across the province.
